desc: Scientifically designed with a special contoured shape that hugs the contours of your gun. Features include: proportioned finger grooves, our unique Cobblestone texture and ambidextrous palm swells for a comfortable, non-slip surface. Easy to install with no lubrication required. These grips are tough and impervious to all oils and solvents found around firearms.

specs.Firearm Fit: Taurus Medium and Large Frame Revolvers
